passes.label: Passes
passes.means: How much he is involved in the team's passing.
passes.calc: Passes attempted, per 100 of his own team's on-ball events while he was on the pitch.
passes.caveat: Volume, not quality. A deep midfielder in a possession side will always be high.

pass_completion.label: Pass completion
pass_completion.means: Share of his passes that found a team-mate.
pass_completion.caveat: Rises the shorter and more backward the passing. Read it next to forward-pass share, never alone.

pass_completion_pressed.label: Completion under pressure
pass_completion_pressed.means: Whether he keeps the ball when an opponent is closing.
pass_completion_pressed.calc: Completed passes / passes attempted, on passes the provider flagged as made under pressure.
pass_completion_pressed.caveat: The pressure flag is binary. On the Australia board it is calibrated against measured metres: flagged touches had an opponent a median 2.2m away, unflagged 6.0m.

forward_pass_share.label: Forward-pass share
forward_pass_share.means: How often he chooses to play forward.
forward_pass_share.calc: Passes ending more than 2m closer to the opponent goal / all his passes.
forward_pass_share.caveat: A choice, not a skill. Low is right for some roles; it becomes a weakness only when the team has no other route forward.

passes_fwd.label: Forward passes
passes_fwd.calc: Passes ending more than 2m upfield, per 100 team on-ball events.

passes_prog.label: Progressive passes
passes_prog.means: Passes that meaningfully advance the ball.
passes_prog.calc: Completed passes gaining at least 5m and at least 25% of the remaining distance to goal, per 100 team on-ball events.
passes_prog.caveat: The 25% rule makes a 10m pass near the box count the same as a 30m pass from deep, which is the intent.

progressive_share.label: Progressive share
progressive_share.means: How much of his passing is progressive.

entries_f3.label: Final-third entries
entries_f3.means: Passes that move the team into the final third.
entries_f3.calc: Completed passes starting outside and ending inside the final third, per 100 team on-ball events.

passes_into_f3.label: Passes into the final third
passes_into_f3.means: All completed passes landing in the final third.
passes_into_f3.calc: Completed passes ending beyond x=80, per 100 team on-ball events.
passes_into_f3.caveat: Includes passes that started there, unlike final-third entries.

final_third_entry_share.label: Final-third entry share
final_third_entry_share.means: How much of their passing from deeper ends up entering the final third.
final_third_entry_share.calc: Completed passes into the final third / passes attempted from outside it.
final_third_entry_share.caveat: Needs about 239 attempts before it separates players, which most do not reach in a tournament.

entries_box.label: Box entries
entries_box.means: Passes that put the ball in the penalty area.
entries_box.calc: Completed passes ending inside the box from outside it, per 100 team on-ball events.

switches.label: Switches of play
switches.means: Changing the side the attack is on.
switches.calc: Completed passes moving the ball more than 30m across the pitch, per 100 team on-ball events.
switches.caveat: A switch is a tool against a compact block; volume alone does not say it was the right ball.

crosses.label: Crosses
crosses.calc: Passes tagged as crosses, per 100 team on-ball events.

cross_completion.label: Cross completion
cross_completion.means: Share of crosses that found a team-mate.
cross_completion.caveat: Needs about 115 crosses before it separates one player from another. Most players never reach that in a tournament.

key_passes.label: Key passes
key_passes.calc: Passes directly leading to a team-mate's shot, per 100 team on-ball events.

pre_assists.label: Pre-assists
pre_assists.means: The pass before the pass that created the shot.
pre_assists.calc: Completed passes to the player who then made a shot-creating pass, per 100 team on-ball events.
pre_assists.caveat: Credits the build-up rather than only the final ball.

carries.label: Carries
carries.means: How often he moves the ball with his feet.
carries.calc: Carry events, per 100 team on-ball events.

carries_prog.label: Progressive carries
carries_prog.calc: Carries gaining at least 5m upfield, per 100 team on-ball events.

carries_into_f3.label: Carries into the final third
carries_into_f3.means: Beating the line by running, not passing.
carries_into_f3.calc: Carries starting outside and ending inside the final third, per 100 team on-ball events.
carries_into_f3.caveat: The carrying counterpart of a line-breaking pass: the player beat the line himself.

carries_into_box.label: Carries into the box
carries_into_box.means: Running the ball into the penalty area.
carries_into_box.calc: Carries ending inside the box from outside it, per 100 team on-ball events.

dribbles.label: Take-ons
dribbles.means: How often he tries to beat a man.
dribbles.calc: Dribble attempts, per 100 team on-ball events.

dribble_success.label: Take-on success
dribble_success.means: Share of attempts that beat the man.
dribble_success.caveat: Split-half reliability is only 0.17 here: a player's own take-on rate barely repeats between halves of the same sample. Treat it as description, not skill.

receptions.label: Receptions
receptions.means: How often the ball comes to him.
receptions.calc: Completed ball receipts, per 100 team on-ball events.

receptions_pressed.label: Receiving under pressure
receptions_pressed.means: How often he takes the ball with an opponent on him.
receptions_pressed.calc: Receipts flagged under pressure, per 100 team on-ball events.
receptions_pressed.caveat: High is a role description - a striker with his back to goal - not a virtue.

retention_under_pressure.label: Keeping it under pressure
retention_under_pressure.means: Whether the ball survives when he is pressed.
retention_under_pressure.calc: Pressed touches that did not end in a turnover / all pressed touches.
retention_under_pressure.caveat: Combines passing and receiving under pressure into one rate, which is why it stabilises faster than either alone.

touches_box.label: Touches in the box
touches_box.calc: Any on-ball action inside the box, per 100 team on-ball events.

dispossessed.label: Dispossessed
dispossessed.means: Losing the ball to a tackle.
dispossessed.calc: Times tackled out of possession, per 100 team on-ball events.

miscontrol.label: Miscontrols
miscontrol.means: Losing the ball without a challenge.
miscontrol.calc: Failed touches, per 100 team on-ball events.

shots.label: Shots
shots.calc: Non-penalty shots, per 100 team on-ball events.

shot_on_target_share.label: Shots on target
shot_on_target_share.means: Share of shots hitting the goal.
shot_on_target_share.caveat: REFUSED on this board: split-half reliability is -0.40, meaning a player's rate in one half of the sample tells you nothing about the other. It is noise.

xg.label: Expected goals
xg.means: The quality of the chances he got on the end of.
xg.calc: The provider's shot model, summed over his non-penalty shots.

xa.label: Expected assists
xa.means: The quality of the chances he created.
xa.calc: The expected-goals value of the shots his passes set up.
xa.caveat: Credits the passer with the shooter's shot selection, which is the standard flaw in this metric.

xgot.label: Post-shot xG (xGOT)
xgot.means: How well the shot was struck, given where it ended up in the goal.
xgot.calc: A logistic model on the placement of on-target shots - distance from the centre of the goal, height, and their interaction - with pre-shot xG as an offset so it learns placement rather than chance quality. AUC 0.813 against 0.776 for pre-shot xG alone.
xgot.caveat: Only defined on shots that were on target, and ball speed is not in the data, so a placed pass and a rising drive to the same spot score the same.

pressures.label: Pressures
pressures.means: How often he closes an opponent down.
pressures.calc: Pressure events, per 100 of the opponent's on-ball events while he was on.
pressures.caveat: Only exists on the Australia board: Opta has no pressure event, so the club board cannot show this.

counterpress.label: Counterpressures
counterpress.means: Pressing immediately after losing the ball.
counterpress.calc: Pressures within five seconds of a turnover, per 100 opponent on-ball events.

recoveries.label: Recoveries
recoveries.calc: Ball recoveries, per 100 opponent on-ball events.

interceptions.label: Interceptions
interceptions.means: Reading and cutting out a pass.
interceptions.caveat: Needs roughly 790 minutes before it separates players. Below that it is mostly the prior.

blocks.label: Blocks
blocks.means: Getting in the way of a pass or shot.

clearances.label: Clearances
clearances.means: Getting the ball away under duress.
clearances.caveat: Almost pure exposure: it mostly measures how often the team is under siege.

aerials.label: Aerial duels
aerials.means: How often he contests in the air.
aerials.calc: Aerial duels, per 100 opponent on-ball events.

aerial_win.label: Aerial win rate
aerial_win.calc: Aerials won / aerials contested, shrunk toward the field average for his position.
aerial_win.caveat: Needs about 33 duels before his own data outweighs the prior.

ground_duels.label: Ground duels
ground_duels.means: How often he engages on the floor.
ground_duels.calc: Tackles and challenges, per 100 opponent on-ball events.

ground_duel_win.label: Ground duel win rate
ground_duel_win.calc: Duels won / duels contested, shrunk toward the field average for his position.
ground_duel_win.caveat: Split-half reliability 0.29. Engagement rate is the more repeatable half of this skill.

fouls_won.label: Fouls won
fouls_won.calc: Fouls won, per 100 team on-ball events.

fouls_won_f3.label: Fouls won in the final third
fouls_won_f3.means: Winning free kicks in dangerous areas.
fouls_won_f3.calc: Fouls won beyond x=80, per 100 team on-ball events.
fouls_won_f3.caveat: Worth far more than a foul won in your own half: it stops a counter or wins a set piece in a scoring area.

fouls_committed.label: Fouls conceded
fouls_committed.calc: Fouls committed, per 100 opponent on-ball events.

bypassed_per_pass.label: Opponents beaten per forward pass
bypassed_per_pass.means: How many opponents the ball goes past when he plays forward.
bypassed_per_pass.calc: For each completed forward pass, opponents whose position lies between the ball's start and finish and within 10m of the line of the pass, measured from the freeze frame at the moment of the pass.
bypassed_per_pass.caveat: Counts only opponents the broadcast camera could see, so it is an undercount. The ranking is stable between an 8m and an 18m corridor.

composite_defs.Progression: Moving the ball upfield: forward and progressive passes, progressive carries and entries into the final third.
composite_defs.Security in possession: Keeping the ball: completion, retention under pressure, and not being dispossessed or miscontrolling.
composite_defs.Creating: Making chances: box entries, key passes and crossing volume.
composite_defs.Creation: Making chances: box entries, key passes and crossing volume.
composite_defs.Pressing: Closing opponents down: pressures and counterpressures per opponent action.
composite_defs.Winning it back: Regaining possession: recoveries, interceptions, blocks and clearances.
composite_defs.Recovery work: Regaining possession: recoveries, interceptions, blocks and clearances.
composite_defs.Duels: Contesting the ball: aerial and ground duel win rates, and how often he engages at all.
composite_defs.Carrying: Moving the ball with his feet: carries, take-ons and receiving under pressure.

matildas.headline: the Matildas' chance creation runs through Steph Catley.
evidence: 16% of the squad's chance creation actions, 2.1 times the 8% an even split across the 13 outfielders used would give
20 of 126 actions in 710 minutes, from full back
matildas.so: Screening that player does not redirect the chance creation route, it removes it. Worth knowing before deciding who to pick up.

matildas.so: Screening that player does not redirect the aerial presence route, it removes it. Worth knowing before deciding who to pick up.

matildas.headline: the Matildas can win duels because Clare Hunt does it from centre back.
evidence: Clare Hunt +0.79 SD against others in the same position
the team +0.68 SD against the field on the same quality
matildas.so: The route exists because of that player rather than as a team habit that would survive their absence.

socceroos.headline: the Socceroos are most gettable at pressing.
evidence: the team -1.21 SD against the field, 80% range -1.41 to -0.97
weakest in the squad: Aziz Behich (full back, -1.39), Aaron Mooy (holding midfielder, -1.35), Mitchell Duke (forward, -1.13)
socceroos.so: Make the game about pressing. It is the part of it they are least equipped to win, and the players above are where it breaks first.

socceroos.headline: the Socceroos are most gettable at winning the ball back.
evidence: the team -0.83 SD against the field, 80% range -1.12 to -0.50
socceroos.so: Make the game about winning the ball back. It is the part of it they are least equipped to win, though no individual stands out as the cause.
